name: Should I choose a walk-in shower or keep a tub?

mainEntity.name: Is a walk-in shower or a tub better for a bathroom renovation in a Los Angeles home?
mainEntity.text: Is a walk-in shower or a tub better for a bathroom renovation in a Los Angeles home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The right choice depends on lifestyle, space, and long-term plans. A walk-in shower often makes a bathroom feel larger and is easier to use day to day, especially in a primary bath. A tub can still be the better fit for family homes, guest bathrooms, or buyers who want bathing options. In smaller bathrooms, removing a bulky tub may free up space for better storage or a larger shower. Before deciding, consider who uses the room most, whether aging-in-place matters, and whether the project is in a main bath or a secondary bath. If resale is a concern, many homeowners keep at least one tub somewhere in the home. The best remodels match the fixture choice to the room’s purpose instead of following a trend alone.
acceptedAnswer.description: A walk-in shower is often the better choice for daily convenience, accessibility, and a modern look, while a tub is better if you have young children, want to preserve resale flexibility, or need a bathing option. The best choice depends on how the bathroom will be used.
